title: Creamy Curry Chicken with Vegetables & Rice
author: Family Recipe

step.title: Marinate chicken
step.text: If possible, soak the chicken in curry powder and soy sauce for a while so it absorbs the flavor.

step.title: Marinate chicken
step.text: Add soy sauce to the chicken along with the curry powder and mix well.

step.title: Sauté onions
step.text: Quickly sauté the onions in a little vegetable oil until softened. There is no need to brown them.

step.title: Season chicken
step.text: Add the chicken to the onions and season with salt and pepper.

step.title: Add vegetables
step.text: Once the chicken is fully cooked, add the washed frozen carrots and peas.

step.title: Add mini corn
step.text: Add the canned mini corn and mix everything together.

step.title: Prepare sauce
step.text: In a separate small pot, add the flour, Maggi seasoning, vegetable oil, and cold water.

step.title: Prepare sauce
step.text: Add Maggi seasoning to the sauce mixture.

step.title: Prepare sauce
step.text: Add vegetable oil to the sauce mixture.

step.title: Add cold water
step.text: Slowly add 4–6 cups of cold water while whisking continuously. Cold water is important to prevent the flour from forming lumps.

step.title: Add cream
step.text: Add the heavy whipping cream (qeshta) and whisk until the sauce is smooth.

step.title: Prepare rice
step.text: Prepare the rice separately in another pot.

steps.title: Combine and cook
steps.text: Pour the creamy sauce directly into the pot with the chicken and vegetables. Mix everything together and let it cook until the sauce is well combined and everything is heated through.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve the creamy curry chicken and vegetables with the rice.

notes: Use cold water when mixing with flour to prevent lumps. The sauce can be prepared separately, but the family method is to add it directly to the chicken and vegetables and let everything cook together.
